about-intro:
Full stack developer with 4+ years building high-demand systems: Laravel and Node.js/TypeScript on the backend, Angular and Vue 3 on the front end. Integrated 50+ certified suppliers into a B2B travel platform processing 50K+ searches per day.
Experienced in data engineering (10M+ records), recurring payments, E2E testing with Playwright and AI features in production (OpenAI, Claude API).
